title_o: Some Thing to Talk About? Differential Story Utility From Experiential and Material Purchases

replications.quote: We successfully replicated Kumar and Gilovich’s effects. Like the original, participants were more bothered by the idea of not sharing an experiential purchase ( M = 4.87, SD = 2.28) than the idea of not sharing a materialistic purchase ( M = 3.73, SD = 2.23), t (381) = 4.98, p one-tailed < .001, d = .51 [.31, .71].
